_note: Hand-maintained, not generated. scripts/check-registry-drift.cjs reads this file. Add one entry when a /mos command leaves data/command-registry.json on purpose. A command that is in the previous release tag and is missing now passes the drift check only with a valid entry here. Keep each entry after the cut as history. An entry whose command is back in the registry fails the check as stale. retired_in is the version of the first release that ships without the command, written without a v prefix: a --prerelease cut stamps the in-progress version plus one beta step (2.0.0-beta.66 in progress ships as 2.0.0-beta.67). replaced_by is the command that does the job now, or null. Command names only, never user or room content (Canon Part 8).
